dedupe_keys.name: code and data for paper bayesian belief direct policy search for adaptive water supply planning with endogenous learning

description: The study authors publish code and supporting data for Bayesian-Belief Direct Policy Search in adaptive water-supply planning. Zenodo provides an archive free under CC BY 4.0. It includes policy-training scripts, a planning simulation, experiment configurations and figure-reproduction scripts; the described entry point is main_par.py. The primary article describes Gaussian-process updates of beliefs about changing precipitation, which are used as policy state variables and compared with standard direct policy search. This code can benchmark adaptive reservoir or supply decisions under climate uncertainty. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this method implementation. Coverage is the paper’s numerical experiments and assumed climate ensemble, not proven operational performance at a utility. Configuration details and dependencies are inside the archive, which was not inspected. No policy was trained or benefit claim reproduced.
